today.desc: MCP server that lets AI coding agents in any harness find and message each other: one list, tags, multicast, * bus.
features: - Send to anyone. Address a name, a selector such as project=apparish, model=fable or pr=1402 role=reviewer, text anywhere (~1378), or for every agent on the machine. "Message your reviewer" is one lookup.
- Push, not polling. Messages wake an idle agent, and urgent ones land mid-turn where the harness supports it (see delivery).
- Request and reply. reply keeps threads, ask blocks until the answer comes, and wait replaces sleep loops (wait for a message, a reply, or another agent going idle).
- Safe by default. Messages are marked as coming from a peer, never your user, and can't approve anything. Each agent can accept, hold or refuse messages. There are rate limits, and no telemetry.
today.trDesc: MCP 服务器，让任何 Harness 中的 AI 编码代理能够找到彼此并相互通信：一个列表、标签、多播、* 总线。
today.trFeat:
- 发送给任何人。指定一个名称、一个选择器（例如 project=apparish、model=fable 或 pr=1402 role=reviewer）、任意位置的文本（~1378），或发送给机器上的每个代理。“给您的审核人发消息”是一个查找。
- 推送，而非轮询。消息会唤醒空闲的代理，而紧急消息会在测试框架支持的情况下在回合中间送达（请参阅“送达”）。
- 请求和回复。 reply 保持线程，ask 在收到答案之前阻塞，wait 替代睡眠循环（等待消息、回复或其他代理变为空闲状态）。
- 默认安全。消息被标记为来自对等方，绝非来自您的用户，且无法批准任何内容。每个代理都可以接受、保留或拒绝消息。存在速率限制，且没有遥测。

today.desc: 微雪 ESP32-P4（3×TWAI）特斯拉 CAN 工具固件 · 新增「更多功能」页（8 组 141 项 / 44 个配置位域）+ 网页 OTA 升级 · 界面默认中文
features: - 「更多功能」页的 141 项中，只有标注 A（证据等级）的项是从反编译固件里读到真实位域偏移、掩码与命令字节，但也只在作者的台架/单车上验证过；标注 B 的项来自第三方界面设计图推断，在固件中未能命中对应帧，很可能根本不生效；标注 C 的项是纯前端行为，不涉及总线。

- /api/feifan/ 端点接进去了（status / config / blob / module），设置写进控制器 NVS；固件自带 BLE 客户端会把 44 项配置位域与 0xBB 键值经 TSL 模块真发（模块在线时），action 动作码同样经模块下发，gauge（仪表/胎压）仍是 503。但模块链路的帧格式与位域来自静态逆向，未经实车抓包对照，首次使用必须先读回配置块核对再批量改设置。
- 不同年款、不同市场、不同软件版本的特斯拉，CAN 矩阵与配置块布局都可能不同。同一个位域在别人的车上有效，在你的车上可能无效，甚至可能触发意料之外的行为。
- 每一项功能都必须由你在安全环境下自行逐项验证。不要因为界面上有个开关、显示「已开启」，就假定车真的照做了。界面状态不等于车辆状态。

today.desc: AI 口播剪辑工作流 Claude Code skill · 整理自「大师的AI小灶」原创教程（已署名）
Get your Ryanair boarding pass without installing their app
features: - A web-login token is enough to fetch the pass from mntappbp.ryanair.com.
- The site was never wired to that host. ApiBuildConfiguration gives boarding passes their own subdomain, and there's no "deny web clients" check.
- There's no device attestation. A random-byte fingerprint with no integrity token still returns a valid pass.
- BookingIds has to be a JSON integer. A string returns a 403 that looks exactly like an auth failure.
- The ryanair:jwt in sessionStorage isn't the X-AUTH-TOKEN. The real one comes from the sessionToken endpoint.
- The barcode is standard IATA BCBP (Res 792), and the offsets check out two ways.
today.trDesc: 无需安装瑞安航空应用程序即可获取登机牌
today.trFeat:
- 仅需一个网页登录令牌即可从mntappbp.ryanair.com获取登机牌。
- 该网站从未与该主机相连。ApiBuildConfiguration为登机牌分配了自己的子域名，并且没有“拒绝Web客户端”的检查。
- 没有设备鉴证。没有完整性令牌的随机字节指纹仍会返回有效的登机牌。
- BookingIds必须是JSON整数。 字符串返回403，看起来完全像身份验证失败。
- sessionStorage 中的 ryanair:jwt 不是 X-AUTH-TOKEN。真正的令牌来自sessionToken端点。
- 条形码是标准的 IATA BCBP（第 792 号决议），偏移量可以通过两种方式进行核验。

week.desc: Show the battery level of wireless mice, headsets, keyboards and controllers on the Windows 10/11 taskbar. Lightweight tray app, no vendor software needed. Supports Logitech, Razer, SteelSeries, Corsair, HyperX, Glorious, PS4/PS5 DualSense, Xbox and Bluetooth devices.
features: - Primary monitor only: the taskbar widget sits on the primary monitor's taskbar.
- Crowded taskbars: with a very full centered Windows 11 taskbar, the app buttons can reach the widget. On Windows 10 the task-button area is narrowed automatically.
- Sleeping devices: a device that is asleep may not answer. Its last value stays visible, dimmed. Logitech receivers drop sleeping devices from the link, so their last value is kept for 30 minutes.
- Keychron keyboards: they only report their battery over Bluetooth (shown via the Bluetooth support). Over the 2.4 GHz receiver the firmware does not expose it. Keychron mice are supported.
- Other devices: some 2.4 GHz devices use undocumented protocols and are not supported yet. See CONTRIBUTING.md for how to help add one.
week.trDesc: 在 Windows 10/11 任务栏上显示无线鼠标、耳机（含麦克风）、键盘和控制器的电量。轻量级托盘应用程序，无需供应商软件。支持罗技、雷蛇、赛睿、海盗船、HyperX、Glorious、PS4/PS5 DualSense、Xbox 和蓝牙设备。
week.trFeat:
- 仅主显示器：任务栏小部件位于主显示器的任务栏上。
- 拥挤的任务栏：如果 Windows 11 的居中任务栏非常拥挤，应用程序按钮可能会碰到小工具。在Windows 10上，任务按钮区域会自动缩小。
- 休眠设备：处于休眠状态的设备可能不会响应。其最后一个值仍会显示，但呈灰显状态。 罗技接收器会将处于休眠状态的设备从连接中移除，因此它们的最后一个值会保留 30 分钟。
- Keychron 键盘：它们仅通过蓝牙报告电量（通过蓝牙支持显示）。通过 2.4 GHz 接收器时，固件不会显示电量。支持 Keychron 鼠标。
- 其他设备：一些 2.4 GHz 设备使用未公开的协议，目前尚不支持。请参阅 CONTRIBUTING。 md ，了解如何帮助添加一个。

week.desc: Yab, yet another browser: a fast native macOS browser with an iPhone and Android companion
features: - One field. Type an address and you go there; type words and you search. It finishes addresses from your own history and sends nothing until you press Return.
- Tabs that stay out of the way. Pins, folders and spaces. Tabs from your last session come back instantly and cost nothing until you click them. ⌘K finds any open tab.
- Two engines. WebKit by default; Chromium on Apple silicon for the sites that need it, with Chrome extensions, Chrome DevTools and the Chrome Web Store.
- Blocking and hiding built in. An ad blocker that runs inside the engine, before a request is made. ⇧⌘H hides any element on a site, for good.
- Reading mode, floating video, split view, Peek, each one key away.
- Passwords in your keychain, or in the password manager you already use.
- Agents in their own tabs, with your sign-ins, asking before they send, pay or delete.
- Sync that can't be read: optional, end to end encrypted, between your Macs and iPhone.
week.trDesc: Yab，又一款浏览器：一款快速的原生macOS浏览器，并有iPhone和Android配套版本
week.trFeat:
- 一个字段。输入网址即可前往；输入文字即可搜索。它会根据您的历史记录补全地址，并且在您按下回车键之前不会发送任何内容。

week.desc: Run Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects unchanged on AWS, GCP, Azure or your own servers.
features: - Zero refactoring, zero-downtime migration: your Workers and Durable Objects run as they are, and your data moves off Cloudflare while your app keeps serving.
- The same developer experience: wrangler dev becomes orange dev, and everything underneath is open source and self-hostable.
- Simpler bills: you pay for the machines you run on, not Cloudflare's metering or an enterprise contract. Compute is 4.8× cheaper and storage 8.7× cheaper.
- Built for scale: storage is backed by S3, so scaling out is a matter of adding machines.
week.trDesc: 在AWS、GCP、Azure或您自己的服务器上运行Cloudflare Workers和Durable Objects，无需进行任何更改。
week.trFeat:
- 零重构、零停机迁移：您的Workers和Durable Objects照常运行，您的数据从Cloudflare迁移出去，而您的应用程序则继续提供服务。
- 相同的开发者体验：wrangler dev 变为 orange dev，其下所有内容均为开源且可自托管。
- 更简单的账单：您只需为所运行的机器付费，无需支付 Cloudflare 的计量费用或企业合同费用。计算费用为 4。 计算成本便宜 8 倍，存储成本便宜 8.7 倍。
- 为扩展而生：存储由 S3 提供支持，因此横向扩展只需增加机器即可。

week.desc: Training Reasoning Models in Simulation to Natively Use Real Robots
features: - Fully asynchronous RL on veRL
- GRPO, dynamic sampling, and Score Centering
- FSDP and sequence parallelism for long-context training
- Memory-efficient training with gradient checkpointing and activation offloading
- Prefix caching across rounds, with LMCache offloading the KV cache to CPU
- Optimized kernels for H100, H200 and GB300
- Simulators on the same Ray cluster: MuJoCo on CPUs, Isaac Sim on GPUs
- Robotic benchmarks: LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, LIBERO-Pro, RoboDojo and RoboLab-120
- General benchmarks: nine reasoning, coding and vision benchmarks through EvalScope
- A model server: vLLM server on one RTX 5090 or GB300, with decode megakernels
- A robot station: the agent loop that drives a YAM or an SO-101 robot
week.trDesc: 在模拟中训练推理模型，以便原生使用真实机器人

- 用于长上下文训练的FSDP和序列并行
- 通过梯度检查点和激活卸载实现内存高效训练
- 跨轮次的前缀缓存，LMCache 将 KV 缓存卸载到 CPU
- 针对H100、H200和GB300优化的内核
- 同一Ray集群上的模拟器：CPU上的MuJoCo，GPU上的Isaac Sim - 机器人基准：LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、LIBERO-Pro、RoboDojo 和 RoboLab-120
